english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that lasts a long time and resists wear.
Use this when something stays serviceable despite physical wear and tear or prolonged use.

examples.english: These shoes are quite durable; even after wearing them for a year, they’re still pretty new.
examples.traditional: 呢對鞋幾襟用，着咗成年都仲好新。
examples.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 haai4 gei2 kam1 jung6 zoek3 zo2 sing4 nin4 dou1 zung6 hou2 san1

examples.english: This phone is really impervious to wear and tear—it is still working after years of use.
examples.traditional: 呢部電話真係襟用，用咗幾年都仲冇壞。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 kam1 jung6 jung6 zo2 gei2 nin4 dou1 zung6 mou5 waai6
